> Say what kind of file a path is - the mzLib file type, its extension, its reader and the cross-format views it offers - without parsing its contents.

Wire verb `readers identify` · Python [`pymzlib.readers.identify`][pymzlib.readers.identify]

### Wraps

- [`FileReader.ReadResultFile`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/FileReader.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/FileReader.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SupportedFileTypeExtensions.ParseFileType`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Util/SupportedFileTypes.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Util/SupportedFileTypes.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `path` | required | — | — | Any file (or Bruker .d directory). For many paths see the caveat on --paths-stdin. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path identified. |
| `file_type` | `string` | — | never | The mzLib SupportedFileType. |
| `extension` | `string` | — | yes: mzLib maps no extension to this type | The extension mzLib dispatched on. |
| `reader` | `string` | — | never | The mzLib reader class that would parse it. |
| `views` | `string[]` | — | never | The cross-format views it offers; often empty. |
| `error` | `object` | — | yes: always, for a single path; in a paths-stdin entry, the path was identified | {kind, type, message} for a path that failed under on-error skip. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | path missing, blank or not found; mzLib does not recognise the file type |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | paths-stdin with path, offset or limit; paths-stdin with a value; no paths on stdin; a repeated path; threads 0 or below -1; on-error not fail or skip; on-error skip with a single path; out naming an input |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | with on-error fail, an input that is missing or not this view: the usage error of that input, prefixed 'Input <i> (<path>)' |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | out with paths-stdin: identify returns no table |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | a .parquet that exists but cannot be opened, because another process holds it or the user may not read it: IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException from mzLib's detection (since mzLib #1478), not the not-supported usage error |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- Cheap but not pure: mzLib reads a bare .tsv's first line, a .txt's and a .mztab's first five, a .parquet's column schema and a .d directory's listing to dispatch them. A .parquet mzLib can open and read without the DIA-NN report columns (Precursor.Id, Stripped.Sequence, Run), or bytes that are not Parquet at all, is a usage error, 'Parquet file type not supported' (mzLib #1384). One it cannot open is an I/O error instead (#1478).
- No software field: mzLib's Software property is Unspecified for everything its factory builds; file_type already names the tool.
- Many paths (result.bulk): there is no table and no --out, and no record_count, because nothing is read.

### Example

```python
result = pymzlib.readers.identify('PXD078927_msgf_1_1_0.mzid')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`readers_identify_mzid.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/readers_identify_mzid.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

```python
batch = pymzlib.readers.identify_many(['PXD078927_msgf_1_1_0.mzid', 'no-such-run.mzML'], on_error='skip')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`readers_many_identify.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/readers_many_identify.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.
